metadata.description: Sixteen-item school questionnaire covering students' perceived school wellbeing and belonging.
metadata.intended_use: School research and evaluation of students' school-related wellbeing and connectedness.
metadata.development_history: Developed and initially validated with students in grades 6-8.
metadata.measurement_rationale: School belonging, positive affect, and academic efficacy reflect psychosocial conditions relevant to learning and participation.
metadata.interpretation_notes: The initial evidence is age- and language-specific; German validation and exact form rights should be checked before administration.

versions.source_citation: Renshaw et al. (2015). Psychometric properties of the School Well-being Questionnaire.

source_documents.title: School Well-being Questionnaire source publication
source_documents.license_name: Metadata reference; exact German edition and reuse terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.
